verdict.rationale: Mailgun is an email-delivery API service, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is outside its product role. Its documented official MCP server (mailgun-docs-30) is the server side, where other assistants call Mailgun, so it does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
